newsitem.title: USA: Albank to purchase First Union branches.
newsitem.headline: Albank to purchase First Union branches.

text.p: Albank Financial Corp said Thursday it agreed to purchase three New York state banking offices from First Union Corp.
Albank said it will assume deposit liabilities of about $33.5 million.
Albank said the transaction, subject to approval by bank regulators, is expected to close at year-end. Terms were not disclosed.

Albank said all three, located in Middletown, Port Jervis and Beacon, New York, will be consolidated with its existing branch network. All First Union employees at the branches as of the closing date will be offered employment, Albank said.
Albank Financial Corp is the holding company for ALBANK FSB, the oldest operating savings bank in New York state.
